title: A landing: "hold" PR was auto-merged anyway — the per-branch arming file survives on main, so every later PR from that branch is pre-armed
note:
WAVE 2, operator-selected 2026-09-24 ~15:55Z (popup). Dispatched by session_01Ljhs6sFAdWHdMDhJpL5aBP. OBSERVED 2026-09-24 by session_01Ljhs6sFAdWHdMDhJpL5aBP. #12858 declared landing "hold" with hold_reason changes_landing_machinery (pr-landing-guard R12: exit 0, state=declared_hold). github-actions[bot] merged it anyway at 13:53:00Z. Cause (INFERRED, to verify): .github/pr-automerge-requests/tender-mayer-2g1vtq.txt had landed on main with #12838, and claude-pr-automerge appears to key on the file existing on the branch, ignoring whether it changed vs main and ignoring the landing declaration. Consequence: a branch that has self-landed once stays armed for every later PR. That PR can be a Tier-2/3 hold, which is exactly the case R12 and the hold reasons exist for. The content that merged was the intended content and CI was green, so no damage this time; the control failed silently. FIX: the automerge workflow must refuse when the landing declaration says hold, and arming files should be deleted on merge. Verify the cause against the workflow before building. Tier-1 (CI).
OPERATOR 2026-09-24 ~17:10Z, popup in session_01Ljhs6sFAdWHdMDhJpL5aBP, verbatim: "Manager reads + merges" (the R12 human read of #12870 and #12876 is delegated to the manager). MANAGER READ of #12870: sound and strictly subtractive. The landing gate arms only on landing=="self" or when there is no declaration; the request gate compares against the merge-base; automerge_landing_gate.py is added to LANDING_MACHINERY. Merge once CI is green.
[2026-09-25T07:35Z manager] #12870 merged 2026-09-24 (merge-base request gate in claude-pr-automerge.yml).
